idea-plugin.name: fixlock
idea-plugin.description:
Fixed stays fixed. fixlock locks the lines that fix a bug or finish a feature, so an AI assistant, a teammate or a merge can't quietly undo them.

  • Locked lines are visible: a lock in the gutter and a light background. Hover for why the code exists, the linked issue and who must approve a change.
  • Live warnings: when an edit, yours or your AI assistant's, undoes a locked fix, the lock turns amber, a banner appears above the file and you get one alert. Reformatting and comments don't count (structural matching, the same as CI).
  • One-click setup: open a git repository and click Set up fixlock. No questions: your team, the past fixes fixlock is surest about, commit hooks and the GitHub PR check.
  • Lock in two clicks: select lines, right-click, Lock Selected Lines.
  • Run CI locally: check your branch or staged changes from the Tools menu.

Works in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, GoLand, Rider, CLion, RubyMine, RustRover, DataGrip and Android Studio, for any language.

The plugin runs the fixlock command-line tool: your project's copy if it has one, else fixlock on PATH (pipx install fixlock, no Node.js needed), else npx. Nothing leaves your machine.
